purpose: Machine-readable lock between qualitative demand/friction signals and permanent synthetic regressions in the single Stödassistenten learning system. A mapping proves that a product miss has an eval memory; it does not prove eligibility or factual truth.

mappings.product_miss: Everyday 'underhåll' language can collapse direct parent-paid underhållsbidrag and Försäkringskassan underhållsstöd into the same route.
mappings.fix_or_guardrail: Require residence/payment facts, keep the two routes distinct and block automatic/amount claims without current primary-source verification.

mappings.product_miss: A user can assume employer approval alone makes a changed part-time sickness-benefit schedule safe.
mappings.fix_or_guardrail: Require the proposed work distribution/extent and preserve coordination with both employer and Försäkringskassan before benefit-related schedule claims.

mappings.product_miss: A person describing extensive help at home can be sent to the wrong authority or treated as eligible from diagnosis/rough hours alone.
mappings.fix_or_guardrail: Separate municipal personal-assistance assessment from state assistansersättning, ask about functional basic-needs help and fail closed on entitlement/hour estimates.

mappings.product_miss: Funding-only companies were asked procurement-readiness and free-text questions that did not change the funding route.
mappings.fix_or_guardrail: Keep the shorter information-gain path and prevent procurement readiness from leaking into funding-only advice.

mappings.product_miss: Young users can treat all paid housing as equivalent or delay reporting income/household changes, increasing missed-support or repayment risk.
mappings.fix_or_guardrail: Preserve housing-form classification, current-income/change reporting and primary-source verification, including irregular-income handling that must not promise an amount or no repayment.

mappings.product_miss: A person can treat a warning of possible redundancy as if unemployment has already started, or wait too long once employment actually ends because union, a-kassa and transition support are conflated.
mappings.fix_or_guardrail: Establish current employment status first, separate preparation/transition support from first-unemployed-day registration, and keep union, a-kassa and transition routes distinct.

mappings.product_miss: A helper can assume family relationship alone authorizes representation or can be told to use the supported person's credentials instead of the correct representative route.
mappings.fix_or_guardrail: Check relationship, capacity and existing representative arrangements; require own e-identification where the official authorized-relative web route applies and fail closed on representation authority.

mappings.product_miss: A person with a functional housing barrier can wrongly be screened out because the home is rented, or receive an unusable next step that ignores the owner and other right-holders whose written consent can be required before a positive municipal decision.
mappings.fix_or_guardrail: Keep the person with the functional need as the applicant path, ask tenure/ownership/right-holder facts only when they change the process, and require current Boverket plus municipal verification of written consent without turning consent into entitlement.

mappings.product_miss: A guardian can follow the old 90-day VAB habit or assume that ordinary VAB conditions remain unchanged after the child turns 12, causing a late application or missing medical documentation.
mappings.fix_or_guardrail: Surface the post-1-April-2026 30-day window, distinguish age 12-15 conditions, ask whether a prior decision exists, and preserve current medical-statement rules without promising entitlement or payment.

mappings.product_miss: A part-time sick-listed parent can treat the sickness percentage as if it automatically defines the VAB percentage, ignoring exact hour placement, the parent's own sick-reported time and other same-day benefits.
mappings.fix_or_guardrail: Ask only the hour-level facts that can change the route, block same-hour double-benefit assumptions, and preserve coordination of part-time sickness-benefit work-time placement with Försäkringskassan and the employer.

mappings.product_miss: A BRF or landlord can be routed as if it were the initial housing-adaptation applicant, or can conflate owner consent with the separate voluntary takeover route for an already granted cash grant in common areas.
mappings.fix_or_guardrail: Keep the resident as initial applicant, distinguish inside-apartment from common-area measures and consent from takeover, require the positive cash-grant and written-agreement prerequisites before owner takeover, and keep repair/restoration consequences separate.
